anchors.description: Horizontal width of the built-in microwave front panel between its left and right outer frame edges at the same height (mid-door level), from original-image point [110,124] to [187,124].
anchors.visible_evidence: Stainless-steel front panel of a built-in microwave set flush into wood cabinetry just under the upper cabinets; the panel measures about 79 px wide by 60 px high (aspect ratio ~1.3), with a dark glass door and a vertical control strip on its right side, consistent with a standard 24-inch built-in microwave.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: No legible brand or model number; built-in microwave widths are typically 24 in (0.61 m) or 27 in (0.69 m), and trim-kit edges add about 1 cm, so the true panel width may differ from the 24-inch category value.
